<policies>
  <inbound>
    <base />
    <set-header name="Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key" exists-action="delete" />
    <set-query-parameter name="subscription-key" exists-action="delete" />
    <set-header name="api-key" exists-action="delete" />
    <validate-content unspecified-content-type-action="prevent" max-size="16384" size-exceeded-action="prevent">
      <content type="application/json" validate-as="json" action="prevent" />
    </validate-content>
    <rate-limit-by-key calls="20" renewal-period="60" counter-key="@("ai-front:" + context.Subscription.Id)" />
    <llm-semantic-cache-lookup score-threshold="0.05" embeddings-backend-id="foundry-embeddings" embeddings-backend-auth="system-assigned" ignore-system-messages="false" max-message-count="2">
      <vary-by>@(context.Subscription.Id)</vary-by>
      <vary-by>__CHAT_DEPLOYMENT__</vary-by>
      <vary-by>__MODEL_PARTITION__</vary-by>
      <vary-by>@(context.Request.Body.As<Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject>(preserveContent: true).Value<int>("max_completion_tokens").ToString())</vary-by>
    </llm-semantic-cache-lookup>
    <rate-limit-by-key calls="10" renewal-period="60" counter-key="@("ai-backend:" + context.Subscription.Id)" />
    <llm-token-limit counter-key="@("utility-ai:" + context.Subscription.Id)" tokens-per-minute="__TOKENS_PER_MINUTE__" token-quota="__TOKENS_PER_DAY__" token-quota-period="Daily" estimate-prompt-tokens="true" remaining-tokens-header-name="x-ai-tokens-remaining" tokens-consumed-header-name="x-ai-tokens-consumed" />
    <llm-emit-token-metric namespace="UtilityAIGateway">
      <dimension name="API ID" />
      <dimension name="Operation ID" />
    </llm-emit-token-metric>
    <emit-metric name="BackendRequests" namespace="UtilityAIGateway" value="1">
      <dimension name="API ID" />
    </emit-metric>
    <set-body>@{
        var body = context.Request.Body.As<Newtonsoft.Json.Linq.JObject>(preserveContent: true);
        body["model"] = "__CHAT_DEPLOYMENT__";
        return body.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None);
    }</set-body>
    <set-backend-service backend-id="foundry-chat" />
    <rewrite-uri template="/chat/completions" copy-unmatched-params="false" />
    <authentication-managed-identity resource="https://cognitiveservices.azure.com/" />
  </inbound>
  <backend>
    <forward-request timeout="60" />
  </backend>
  <outbound>
    <llm-semantic-cache-store duration="60" />
    <base />
  </outbound>
  <on-error>
    <base />
  </on-error>
</policies>
